text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Universe-san, I prepared some sweets to 
celebrate your birthday, but... Um, well—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, I'm not confident whether 
this meets your wishes, Universe-san.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
You mentioned before about a sweet you 
wanted to try. You said it was "DRY" and 
"SOFT," with a "crumbly" texture.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Based on what you said, I tried making 
some. —Okara cookies, that is.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Still, I wonder if this is right... 
Besides, wouldn't something flashier be 
better for a birthday...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Mutef! The 'okara cookies' are what Neo 
Universe wanted to eat!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love's "analysis" is "CRRCT." It 
is deeply "joyous"!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: My, is that true? What a relief...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Well then, shall we get this party 
started?♪ I've baked plenty of okara 
cookies for everyone.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
*Excited*... *restless*... I'm going to 
meet so many "okara cookies"...!
